verdict.rationale: Vanta documents continuous monitoring of systems (vanta-docs-45, vanta-docs-49) and real-time webhook notifications with signature verification and retries (vanta-docs-4). That gives a push mechanism an admin could route into Slack or ticketing with their own glue code. Remediation context comes indirectly: failing tests are queryable via the API and the MCP server can generate a remediation plan (vanta-docs-7, vanta-docs-3). Missing for 10: native Slack or email alert delivery, ticketing integration (e.g. Jira) for findings, confirmation that webhook events cover test failures or drift, and documented fix context included in alerts.
